from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's 2025 Q1 financial data extracted from one report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="2025 Q1 Operating Revenue")
    cash_received_from_sales: float | None = Field(description="2025 Q1 Cash Received from Sales of Goods")
    net_profit: float | None = Field(description="2025 Q1 Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
